description: This file defines the HashTable class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, used for managing collections of IComparable objects with hash-based indexing.

classes.name: HashTable
classes.description: A class implementing a hash table to store IComparable objects, supporting addition, removal, and retrieval by index or hash code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a HashTable, optionally initialized from a source array.

methods.name: addFromSource
methods.description: Adds multiple items to the hash table from an array source.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single IComparable item to the hash table.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified IComparable item from the hash table.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the hash table.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the hash table.

methods.name: getIndexForHashCode
methods.description: Returns the index of the specified hash code in the key map.

methods.name: getByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an item by its index in the hash table.

methods.name: getByHashCode
methods.description: Retrieves an item by its hash code.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the items as an array.
